system_texts: Uncertainty about how many units can be sold and what profit is realistic.
There is disagreement on marketing spend and how it affects profitability.
Lack of thorough user testing is warned as a risk that could cause the product to flop.
The LCD display is very expensive and its price is not filled in.
gold_texts: The LCD was unpriced in the EUR 9.95 total, and its estimated extra cost left production near or above the EUR 12.50 allowance. Marketing also questioned the profit and market-share assumptions.
The proposed testing schedule allowed no redesign of the first-release basic design; the user interface designer warned that an insufficiently tested product might fail before a second generation.
